title: AL Pocket Tools
summary: AL Pocket Tools is a VS Code extension that provides utilities for Dynamics 365 Business Central developers to streamline repetitive development tasks like managing app files, updating versions, and navigating code blocks.
key_points: Collection of small utilities designed to reduce interruptions in AL development workflow
Features include cleaning old app files, managing alpackages, saving/loading launch.json, and updating versions
Includes navigation helpers for region blocks, report triggers, and pragma directives
Lightweight tool designed not to affect performance

quotes.text: AL development involves many small tasks. None of them is too difficult, but they take time and constantly interrupt your flow.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the problem the extension solves for developers

quotes.text: It is a collection of utilities for Dynamics 365 Business Central developers working in AL.
quotes.why_it_matters: Defines the purpose and scope of the tool

quotes.text: It should be small, fast, and shouldn't affect the performance.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the design philosophy to keep the extension lightweight
